user.title: Sign in to the cloud of your boxes
user.description: Sign in with the account of the app. Home Assistant keeps only a token, not the password.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of the account.
data_description.password: Used once for the sign-in; it is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud no longer accepts the stored token. Sign in again with the same account.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of the account.
data_description.password: Used once for the sign-in; it is not stored.

error.unknown: The cloud answered unexpectedly. See the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different account than the one set up.

invalid_auth.message: The cloud no longer accepts the sign-in.

command_failed.message: The box did not get the command: {error}

box_unknown.message: The box is no longer in the account.

volume_unknown.message: The box has not reported its volume yet.

nothing_plays.message: No figure is on the box.

alarm_due.message: An alarm of a bedtime schedule rings at {time}; this would cancel it. Switch the schedule's alarm off on the Storybox Plus page first.

unknown_chapter.message: The figure has no such chapter.

other_figure.message: Another figure is on the box now.

no_favourites.message: The figure on the box has no favourite chapters.

tune_plays.message: A Tune lies on the figure; the box plays the Tune, whose chapters take no stars.

figure_unknown.message: No figure is named "{figure}". Use the name as the Storybox Plus page shows it, or the figure's ID.

figure_ambiguous.message: {count} creative figures are named "{figure}". Use the figure's ID instead.

not_creative.message: "{figure}" is no creative figure; only those take chapters.

cloud_failed.message: The cloud did not take the change: {error}

media_unreadable.message: The media could not be read: {error}

too_few_chapters.message: "{figure}" has fewer than two chapters; there is nothing to shuffle.

not_a_box.message: {entity} is no Toniebox 2 of Storybox Plus.

set_sleep_timer.name: Set sleep timer
set_sleep_timer.description: Lets the box fall asleep on its own after the given number of minutes. A running timer is replaced.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes until the box falls asleep (at most 1092).

clear_sleep_timer.name: Clear sleep timer
clear_sleep_timer.description: Cancels the running sleep timer of the box.

set_favourite.name: Set favourite chapter
set_favourite.description: Marks a chapter of the figure on the box as a favourite, or takes the star off.

chapter.name: Chapter
chapter.description: The chapter, counted from 1. Without it, the chapter that plays.

favourite.name: Favourite
favourite.description: On marks the chapter, off takes the star off. Without it, the star changes sides.

play_favourite.name: Play next favourite
play_favourite.description: Plays the next favourite chapter of the figure on the box; after the last one, the first.

add_chapter.name: Add chapter
add_chapter.description: For automations: adds a chapter to a creative figure, from a media source, a text the account's voice speaks, or a video link. By hand this is easier on the Storybox Plus page.

figure.name: Figure
figure.description: The creative figure, by its name as the Storybox Plus page shows it, or by its ID.

media.name: Media
media.description: An audio file or a spoken text from the media browser.

text.name: Text
text.description: A text the voice chosen on the page speaks as the chapter.

url.name: Video link
url.description: A web link whose audio the Media Fetcher app fetches.

title.name: Title
title.description: The chapter's name. Without it: the file name, the first words of the text or the video's title.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Removes the chapters with the same title afterwards, so a daily greeting does not pile up.

remove_chapters.name: Remove chapters
remove_chapters.description: For automations: removes the chapters of a title, or all but the last ones, from a creative figure. The removed audio is gone; the cloud keeps no copy.

figure.name: Figure
figure.description: The creative figure, by its name as the Storybox Plus page shows it, or by its ID.

title.name: Title
title.description: Removes every chapter with this title (any case).

keep_last.name: Keep the last
keep_last.description: Keeps this many chapters at the end of the list and removes the others; 0 removes all.

shuffle_chapters.name: Shuffle chapters
shuffle_chapters.description: For automations: puts the chapters of a creative figure into a new random order. The cloud converts the figure anew.

figure.name: Figure
figure.description: The creative figure, by its name as the Storybox Plus page shows it, or by its ID.

set_box_settings.name: Change box settings
set_box_settings.description: For automations: changes settings of a Toniebox 2, as the save button on the Storybox Plus page does. Only the given settings change.

skipping_enabled.name: Skip by tapping
skipping_enabled.description: Tapping the box skips to the next or previous chapter.

skipping_direction.name: Tapping side
skipping_direction.description: Which side of the box skips forward: left or right.

scrubbing_enabled.name: Wind by tilting
scrubbing_enabled.description: Tilting the box winds forward or back.
